/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ae-alamdara-rasha.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
metadata, roman_and_body = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
updated = roman.decode()
for before, after in {
    'Ae alamdara': 'Ae alamdaara',
    'ae alamdar': 'ae alamdaar',
    'Ae alamdar ': 'Ae alamdaar ',
    'ke pare haiṅ besar': 'ke pare haiṅ be sar',
    'dasht-e-bayabaaṅ': 'dasht-e-bayaabaaṅ',
    'kar aada': 'kar aadaa',
    'Berida balwe': 'Be rida balwe',
    'waawaila': 'waawailaa',
    'Bewatan tishna': 'Be watan tishna',
    'bharam tut gaya': 'bharam tut gaya',
    'Haaye beaas': 'Haaye be aas',
    '    ': '    ',
}.items():
    updated = updated.replace(before, after)
result = metadata + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body
assert result.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
source_lines = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
roman_lines = updated.strip().splitlines()
assert len(source_lines) == len(roman_lines)
assert all(bool(source.strip()) == bool(phonetic.strip()) for source, phonetic in zip(source_lines, roman_lines))
assert [s for s in roman_lines if s.strip().isdigit()] == [f'  {n}' for n in range(1, 8)]
p.write_bytes(result)
PY
